description: Why isn't my x402 API in the Bazaar? Listing lint checks an x402 endpoint for Bazaar indexing: one unpaid call validates its 402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, discovery metadata, input and output schemas, description limits and service name against the indexing rules, with a fix for each problem and the fixed 402 ready to paste, graded as the weekly report card would grade it. Also lints A2A agent cards. Use when an agent needs to lint an x402 listing or A2A agent card before its first sale. Price: $0.01 in USDC per call, paid with x402 inside the tool call. Failed calls aren't charged.
